name: onecal-unified-calendar
title: OneCal Unified Calendar
description: View your OneCal unified calendar in Raycast - all events across synced calendars, with clone events hidden
author: keito4

commands.name: unified-calendar
commands.title: Unified Calendar
commands.subtitle: OneCal
commands.description: List events from all synced calendars (clone events hidden by default)

preferences.name: clientId
preferences.title: OneCal MCP Client ID
preferences.description: Client ID of the MCP client created in OneCal Settings > MCP Config

preferences.name: clientSecret
preferences.title: OneCal MCP Client Secret
preferences.description: Client Secret of the MCP client (shown only once at creation)

preferences.name: daysAhead
preferences.title: Days to Show
preferences.description: How many days of events to show from the start date

preferences.name: hideClones
preferences.title: Clone Events
preferences.label: Hide clone events created by OneCal Sync
preferences.description: Same behavior as "Hide Clone Events" in the OneCal Unified Calendar View
